scope: Additive Invisibility Vial L1-18 audit of Queen invisibility, extra shot damage, Rage, Magic Mirror and targetability timing.
game_version: Official 2023-12 launch, 2024-02 Rage interaction fix and 2024-09 Magic Mirror clone fix; claimed client build 18.600.3 in dated 2026 table; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: Hero Equipment
facts: Invisibility Vial is Common active Archer Queen Equipment that makes the Queen invisible, increases damage and increases HP.
An active Equipment effect requires manual activation and each Hero has two Equipment slots.
sources.limitations: The launch article gives no level durations, damage staging, target-loss timing, projectile interaction or collision rule.

sources.title: February 2024 Update - Patch Notes
facts: Supercell says the extra damage from Invisibility Vial is no longer boosted by Rage.
sources.limitations: The note does not specify whether the Queen's base shot damage is boosted by Rage, the Vial's additive/maximum-buff formula or integer rounding.

sources.title: September Update: Full Patch Notes
facts: Supercell fixed Magic Mirror clones so they no longer receive damage boost from Invisibility Vial or any Equipment and no longer receive passive Equipment DPS buffs.
sources.limitations: The patch does not define how the original Queen's Vial damage and clone damage are resolved on the same tick.

sources.title: Coming Soon!
facts: The Invisibility Spell article says invisible units cannot be targeted.
sources.limitations: This is a Spell rule, not a Vial-specific contract. It does not establish Vial target loss, ongoing-projectile impact, splash, trap or retarget timing and is not imported as a Vial rule.

sources.title: Invisibility Vial — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: The TH18 maximum is L18 and the public per-level Queen HP, ore costs and Blacksmith requirements match the pinned payload. The page describes a stronger attack during Queen invisibility.
sources.limitations: The public table omits current invisibility duration, extra shot damage and timing.

sources.title: Pinned Invisibility Vial Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: All 18 rows retain abilityDuration, damagePerShotIncrease and Queen hitpointIncrease. The pinned duration ranges 4.2 to 7.8 seconds; extra shot damage 340 to 1740; HP 80 to 700.
sources.limitations: The raw fields alone do not establish whether damage is applied on launch or impact, how buffs stack, or how invisibility affects active targets and projectiles.

observations.note: Pinned historical values only. The dated 2026 public table does not expose the effect values, so current continuity remains unverified.

derivations.result: Retain per-level Queen HP and cost as data-only
derivations.method: Cross-check dated claimed-build public table against SHA-pinned normalized fields; no prebattle stat application order is inferred.

derivations.result: Rage must not multiply Vial extra damage if implemented
derivations.method: Apply only the official 2024 bug-fix constraint; base-shot Rage, stacking with other damage buffs and rounding remain unsourced.

derivations.result: Clones exclude Vial and all Equipment damage boosts
derivations.method: Use the official 2024 clone bug-fix constraint, without inferring clone spawn or attack order.

rejected_inferences.rule: Multiply the entire Queen attack by Rage after adding Vial damage
rejected_inferences.reason: Supercell explicitly excludes the Vial's extra damage from Rage amplification.

rejected_inferences.rule: Give Magic Mirror clones the Queen's Vial damage bonus
rejected_inferences.reason: Supercell explicitly removed Equipment damage boosts from clones.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use the Invisibility Spell's full target-loss contract for the Vial
rejected_inferences.reason: The Spell article is not Vial-specific and does not define target, splash, trap or projectile timing.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply the Vial bonus to arrows already in flight
rejected_inferences.reason: Launch versus impact damage capture is not documented.

rejected_inferences.rule: Expire the Vial exactly on the integer tick after pinned duration
rejected_inferences.reason: The activation tick and final attack/targeting phase are not specified.

items: current per-level duration and extra-shot damage continuity
activation command and simultaneous Equipment ordering
Vial start/end tick and final attack eligibility
enemy target loss and reacquisition, in-flight projectile and area-damage handling
trap and Pet interaction during invisibility
base Queen damage versus Vial bonus staging and rounding
Rage, Archer Puppet, Magic Mirror and other modifier interactions
Viewer invisibility overlay, snapshot, replay and RL activation

conclusion: Invisibility Vial L1-18 remains partial and catalogue-only. Official sources establish Queen invisibility, extra damage, Rage exclusion for that extra damage and Magic Mirror clone exclusion. Current duration, damage event staging and targetability timing are not a complete deterministic Core contract.
